```{r}
  theme_bw() +
```

# Read In and Wrangle
```{r}

# Read In
data <- read_xlsx('FINAL Day 3 Reef Futures Workshop Ranking Survey  (Responses).xlsx') %>% select(2:4,6:45) %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var="RowID") %>% 
  mutate(RowID = as.factor(RowID)) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Type = "Which workshop session did you attend (if you attended both, choose your primary area of expertise)?",
                Region = "What primary region do you work in?",
                Sector = "Which sector do you work in?") 

# How many people are from each sector?
data %>% select(Sector, RowID) %>% unique() %>% 
  group_by(Sector) %>% 
  summarise(count = n())

# How about each region?
data %>% select(Region, RowID) %>% unique() %>% 
  group_by(Region) %>% 
  summarise(count = n())

# Make it long!
work_long <- data %>%  
  pivot_longer(5:44 , names_to = "InterventionFull", values_to = "Value") %>% 
  mutate(InterventionFull = as.factor(InterventionFull)) 

# Change the Sector names
region_sub <- data.frame(Sector = c("Academia", "National Government", "Nonprofit", 
                                    "Private/Industry", "State/Local Government"),
                         Sector2 = c("Academia", "Government", "Nonprofit_Private", "Nonprofit_Private", "Government"))
                                    
work_long <- work_long %>% left_join(region_sub, by = "Sector") %>% select(-c(Sector)) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Sector = "Sector2")


# How many people are from each Sector now?
work_long %>% select(Sector, RowID) %>% unique() %>% 
  group_by(Sector) %>% 
  summarise(count = n())



# Change the region names

Bahamas_Caribbean = c("British caribbean territories", "Coastal Central and South America", "Greater Antilles", "Lesser Antilles", "Mesoamerican Barrier Reef", "Entire Caribbean", "The Bahamas", "Gulf of Mexico, campeche bank reefs", "Coastal Central and South America", "TCI/UKOTS") 
pattern <- str_c(Bahamas_Caribbean, collapse = "|")

work_long <- work_long %>% 
  mutate(Region2 = if_else(str_detect(Region, pattern), "Bahamas_Caribbean", "US_FL")) %>% 
  select(-c(Region)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Region = "Region2")
  

# What about region now?
work_long %>% select(Region, RowID) %>% unique() %>% 
  group_by(Region) %>% 
  summarise(count = n())

# Generate Intervention Categories  (1x)
# interventions <- work_long %>% select(Intervention) %>% unique()
# writexl::write_xlsx(interventions, "/Users/migomez/Downloads/interventions.xlsx")
# Then manually add in which one each belongs to

# Read In
categories <- read_xlsx("interventions.xlsx") %>%  
  mutate(InterventionFull = factor(InterventionFull),
         Intervention = factor(Intervention),
         Category = factor(Category, levels = c("Abiotic", "Physiological", "Biotic", "Host", "Symbiont", "Microbiome")))


# Wrangle
work <- work_long %>% 
  left_join(categories, by="InterventionFull") %>% 
  mutate(Type = ifelse(Type =="Session 1 (Tuesday)", "Researcher", "Manager/Practitioner"),
         Type = as.factor(Type),
         Region = as.factor(Region),
         Sector = as.factor(Sector)) %>% select(-c(InterventionFull)) 

work <- work %>% 
  dplyr::rename(InterventionShort = "Intervention") %>% 
  unite("Intervention", Category, InterventionShort, sep = ": ", remove = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(Intervention = factor(Intervention)) %>% 
  mutate(Value = as.factor(Value))

# Create separate dataframe to reorder interventions by
intervention_order <- work %>%
  group_by(Intervention, Value) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Value, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  # arrange(desc(`1`), desc(`2`), desc(`3`), desc(`4`))%>%
  arrange(desc(`2`), desc(`1`), desc(`3`), desc(`4`))%>%
  # arrange(desc(`3`), desc(`1`), desc(`2`), desc(`4`))%>%
  pull(Intervention)

# Set factor levels
work$Intervention <- factor(work$Intervention, levels = intervention_order)

coords <- read_xlsx("coords.xlsx") %>% 
    mutate(Value = as.factor(Value))

work2 <- work %>% 
  mutate(Value = as.factor(Value)) %>% 
  left_join(coords, by="Value")

```

#### All
```{r}
# Pick a category below:

cat <- "Abiotic"
cat <- "Symbiont"
cat <- "Host"
cat <- "Microbiome"
cat <- "Physiological"

# First let's look at all plots for a single category WITH the Researcher and Managers/Practitioners lumped:

# plot everything on quadrant!

  ggplot(., aes(x = overallX, y = overallY)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Category), size = 5) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = InterventionShort),size=4.25,box.padding = 0.45,max.overlaps=100, 
                  segment.color = 'grey50', min.segment.length = unit(0, 'lines')) +
  my_theme +
  scale_color_manual(values = category_colors) +

  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0.23,0.78),limits = c(0,1.03), labels = c("Low", "High"))+

output
```

## Disagreement / Consensus
```{r}

work_diff_abs <- work_sep_perc %>% ungroup() %>% select(c(Type, Intervention, InterventionShort, Value, Percentage)) %>%
  complete(Type, Intervention, Value, fill = list(Percentage = 0)) %>% 
  group_by(Intervention, Value) %>% 
  summarise(diff = diff(Percentage),
            diff_abs = abs(diff(Percentage))) %>% 
  mutate(total = sum(diff_abs)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Intervention = reorder(Intervention, diff_abs)) %>% 
  left_join(ER, by="Value")# %>%  
  # unite("Quadrant", c("Efficacy","Risk"), sep="x", remove=FALSE) %>%

# create new variable differentiating between the agreed up on and disagreed upon interventions
# as determined by qualitative differences in quadrant assignments
riskSector_jump <- read_xlsx("interventions.xlsx", sheet = "sector_risk")
riskRegion_jump <- read_xlsx("interventions.xlsx", sheet = "region_risk")
effRegion_jump <- read_xlsx("interventions.xlsx", sheet = "sector_efficacy")
effSector_jump <- read_xlsx("interventions.xlsx", sheet = "region_efficacy")

disagreements <- riskSector_jump%>%
  full_join(riskRegion_jump)%>%
  full_join(effRegion_jump)%>%
  full_join(effSector_jump)

disagreement_list <- disagreements$Intervention

work_moving_overall <- work_moving_overall%>%
  mutate(disagreement = case_when(
    InterventionShort %in% disagreement_list ~ "yes",
    .default = "no"
  ))


risk_disagreement <- riskSector_jump%>%
  full_join(riskRegion_jump)

risk_list <- risk_disagreement$Intervention

eff_disagreement <- effSector_jump%>%
  full_join(effRegion_jump)

eff_list <- eff_disagreement$Intervention

work_moving_overall <- work_moving_overall%>%
  mutate(risk_disagreement = case_when(
    InterventionShort %in% risk_list ~ "yes",
    .default = "no"
  ))%>%
  mutate(eff_disagreement = case_when (
    InterventionShort %in% eff_list ~ "yes",
    .default = "no"
  ))%>%
  mutate(overall_disagreement = case_when(
    risk_disagreement == "yes" && eff_disagreement == "yes" ~ "both",
    risk_disagreement == "yes" && eff_disagreement == "no" ~ "risk",
    risk_disagreement == "no" && eff_disagreement == "yes" ~ "eff",
    .default = "none"
  ))

table(work_moving_overall$overall_disagreement)
```

### Fisher's test
```{r}
## testing for differences in quadrant assignment by region and sector
# Fisher's exact test because our cell counts can be smaller than 5
fisher_df <- work %>%
  select(RowID, Value, Sector, Region, InterventionShort)%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = InterventionShort, values_from = Value)%>%
  clean_names()%>%
  select(-row_id)

fisher_long <- fisher_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(region, sector),
    names_to = "intervention",
    values_to = "score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(score = factor(score))


run_fisher <- function(data, group_var) {
  
  tab <- table(data[[group_var]], data$score)
  
  # Remove score columns with all 0
  tab <- tab[, colSums(tab) > 0, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Only test if valid table
  if (nrow(tab) > 1 && ncol(tab) > 1) {
    test <- fisher.test(tab)
    return(test$p.value)
  } else {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
}

results <- fisher_long %>%
  group_by(intervention) %>%
  summarise(
    p_geo = run_fisher(cur_data(), "region"),
    p_sector = run_fisher(cur_data(), "sector"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("p_"),
    names_to = "test",
    values_to = "p_value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    test = recode(test,
                  p_geo = "Geographic Location",
                  p_sector = "Professional Sector"),
    p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  )

write.csv(results, file = "quadrant_Fisher.csv")

# testing for regional/sector differences in assignment along risk and efficacy axes
fisher_axes <- fisher_long %>%
  mutate(efficacy = case_when(
    score == 1 ~ "high",
    score == 2 ~ "high",
    score == 3 ~ "low",
    score == 4 ~ "low"
  ))%>%
  mutate(risk = case_when(
    score == 1 ~ "low",
    score == 2 ~ "high",
    score == 3 ~ "low",
    score == 4 ~ "high"
  ))

#efficacy
fisher_efficacy <- fisher_axes%>%
  select(-score, -risk)%>%
  rename("score" = "efficacy")

efficacy_results <- fisher_efficacy %>%
  group_by(intervention) %>%
  summarise(
    p_geo = run_fisher(cur_data(), "region"),
    p_sector = run_fisher(cur_data(), "sector"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("p_"),
    names_to = "test",
    values_to = "p_value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    test = recode(test,
                  p_geo = "Geographic Location",
                  p_sector = "Professional Sector"),
    p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  )

write.csv(efficacy_results, file = "efficacy_Fisher.csv")

#risk
fisher_risk <- fisher_axes%>%
  select(-score, -efficacy)%>%
  rename("score" = "risk")

risk_results <- fisher_risk %>%
  group_by(intervention) %>%
  summarise(
    p_geo = run_fisher(cur_data(), "region"),
    p_sector = run_fisher(cur_data(), "sector"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("p_"),
    names_to = "test",
    values_to = "p_value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    test = recode(test,
                  p_geo = "Geographic Location",
                  p_sector = "Professional Sector"),
    p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  )

write.csv(risk_results, file = "risk_Fisher.csv")

```
